messages:
rina: quick heads-up: cosign verify on base-lite shows signer 'infra-ci' for a prod-key. Digest: sha256:c0ffee1234567890. Not promoted yet but we should triage RBAC/KMS.
oz: Is this from nightly or a manual push? link?
rina: push from gcr://artifacts/builds/4444 tag base-lite:2026-03-23. build link: https://artifacts.example/builds/4444
sam: Can you paste cosign output?
rina: output:
```
Verified OK : sha256:c0ffee1234567890
Signed by: infra-ci@redwood
Key: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-sign/cryptoKeyVersions/12
```
sec-bot: image-scan: minor findings (world-writable /tmp), no SUID. Severity: medium.
oz: Immediate: add digest to denylist, revoke infra-ci KMS sign binding temporarily, and snapshot builder. I'll update denylist.
sec-bot: denylist updated: sha256:c0ffee1234567890 added (TTL 48h)
sam: For longer-term: add IAM condition to KMS allowing signing only for SA with pipeline claim and require a 2-step approval for prod-key versions. Also add prestart runtime verify hook to block non-matching signer.
rina: I'll rebuild with non-root and explicit chmod strip on artifacts. Will post rebuilt digest here.
oz: Filing ticket SEC-3501 to rotate prod-sign key and tighten IAM. Assigning to sam and infra.
sam: OK. I'll draft the rotation playbook and cosign commands before the sync.
rina: Thanks — scheduling a 15-min sync at 10:45 PT to run through roles and timeline. Will update thread after.
